title: RefusalBench: Generative Evaluation of Selective Refusal in Grounded Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures the ability of language models in RAG systems to selectively refuse to answer questions based on flawed context, focusing on six categories of informational uncertainty: ambiguity, contradiction, missing information, false premises, granularity mismatches, and epistemic mismatches.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a focus of the research.
